title: Mustang Alpha (Consolidated Outland, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Mustang Alpha is a light single-seat starter ship from Consolidated Outland in Star Citizen, built from very light metals. A cargo carrier can be added. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: Mustang Alpha: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Mustang Alpha's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Cargo (4 SCU)
controls.text: The Mustang Alpha holds 4 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.
